intent: Keep the generic entry row free of chrome, identity, time and destination. Only canonical lettering may supply readable content; the black field carries the ambiguity.
source:
**Frame:** The upper half of a black page field. A single generic artifact-entry row appears without interface chrome, author, time, path, or recipient.

**Screen / system text:**
`zzHELP_`

**Action:** The continuation after the underscore is obscured before it can identify a convention, purpose, or source.

**Provenance:** `invented` — prefix echo only; not the documented 2026 message.
title: A generic entry row has no visible author or recipient
